_comment: Qualifier PX4 SITL + Gazebo VM: 1 drone over MAVSDK UDP (VM gate V1 = takeoff_demo here). Single drone falls back to the top-level sitl_address + gRPC 50051; multi-drone sitl configs must set per-drone sitl_address ('udpin://0.0.0.0:1454<i>') AND mavsdk_grpc_port (50051+i) plus distinct altitude_band_m — SIM-2 ships configs/sitl3.json. command_timeout_s 30: EKF health-settle on a freshly booted instance is 10-25 s and takeoff includes it (SIM-1 evidence block has the measured number; sizing timeouts is config, never code — sim_sessions.md recap 8). Detection stays off until S8 wires gazebo_video (then: detector backend ultralytics + weights best.pt).
